versions.content: The ARTI description for an OS class shall include an appli- cation mode reference to the interpret the parameter value Type: draft Description: An OS class shall include a reference to a parameter definition that defines how a specific value of the application mode parameter should be interpreted. Rationale: An ARTI consuming tool needs to know how to interpret the values for the application mode, used by this implementation. Dependencies: The ARTI description shall include an OS class definition Use Case: Defining the display for application mode. Supporting Material: -
